title: Synthesis and Characterization of 1,10-Phenanthroline-Linked Imidazolium Salts: Investigation of Their Cytotoxicity Properties.
authors: Karaer Tuncay, Aslihan; Ilhan, Suleyman; Atmaca, Harika; Turkmen, Hayati
one_liner_zh: 该文合成并表征了菲咯啉连接的咪唑盐，评估其细胞毒性和DNA结合常数，并辅以分子对接研究，但核心是抗癌药物开发而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法上仅含简单对接，缺乏AI或物理模拟深度。
abstract: This study focuses on the synthesis, characterization, and anticancer activities of 1,10-phenanthroline-linked imidazolium salts (3) bearing different alkyl groups (methyl-(a), butyl-(b), octyl-(c), dodecyl-(d)) or benzyl (benzyl-(e), 2,4,6-trimethylbenzyl-(f)) groups. The synthesized salts were fully characterized using various analytical techniques, including UV-vis, (1)H NMR, (13)C NMR, FT-IR, and mass spectrometry. Their biological activities were evaluated against DU-145 (prostate cancer), MCF-7 (breast cancer), T98G (glioblastoma cancer), and the nontumorigenic HEK-293 (human embryonic kidney) cell lines. The most potent compound 3e exhibited a remarkable DNA binding constant (K (b) = 1.66 +/- 0.1 x 10(6) M(-1)), indicating a strong interaction with DNA. Additionally, molecular docking studies were performed to assess the interaction of 3e with key apoptotic and cell cycle regulatory proteins (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, CDK1, and Cyclin B1), suggesting a potential mechanism for its anticancer activity. ADME-related analyses of the lead compound 3e were conducted, providing an initial pharmacokinetic profile to support its progression as a preclinical candidate. In cancer cell lines, mitochondrial morphology and integrity were evaluated at IC(50) concentrations against compound 3e using Invitrogen MitoTracker stain. These findings highlight the dual role of 1,10-phenanthroline-linked imidazolium salts as DNA-interacting agents and selective anticancer compounds, paving the way for their further development as targeted chemotherapeutic candidates.
abstract_zh: 本研究聚焦于连接1,10-菲咯啉的咪唑鎓盐（3）的合成、表征及其抗癌活性，这些盐带有不同的烷基（甲基-(a)、丁基-(b)、辛基-(c)、十二烷基-(d)）或苄基（苄基-(e)、2,4,6-三甲基苄基-(f)）基团。通过多种分析技术对合成的盐进行了全面表征，包括紫外-可见光谱（UV-vis）、核磁共振氢谱（(1)H NMR）、核磁共振碳谱（(13)C NMR）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FT-IR）和质谱。其生物活性针对DU-145（前列腺癌）、MCF-7（乳腺癌）、T98G（胶质母细胞瘤癌）以及非致瘤性HEK-293（人胚胎肾）细胞系进行了评估。最具潜力的化合物3e表现出显著的DNA结合常数（K (b) = 1.66 ± 0.1 x 10(6) M(-1)），表明其与DNA有强相互作用。此外，进行了分子对接研究以评估3e与关键凋亡和细胞周期调控蛋白（Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、CDK1和Cyclin B1）的相互作用，提示其抗癌活性的潜在机制。对先导化合物3e进行了ADME相关分析，提供了初步药代动力学特征，以支持其作为临床前候选药物的进展。在癌细胞系中，使用Invitrogen MitoTracker染色在IC(50)浓度下评估了化合物3e对线粒体形态和完整性的影响。这些发现突显了连接1,10-菲咯啉的咪唑鎓盐作为DNA相互作用剂和选择性抗癌化合物的双重作用，为其进一步开发为靶向化疗候选药物铺平了道路。
